reasons: Deviation is correctly identified: the grant in p0022 runs to Client alone and Section 8(c) restricts access to Client's own officers/employees/agents, so affiliates and contractors acting on our behalf are excluded; Section 13(b) terminates the licence on 'any violations or breach' of Sections 8a-8c with no materiality or cure, and Section 15 has no successor-transfer carve-out.

Redline reaches the preferred position with targeted insertions: affiliates/contractors added to the grant, Section 8(c) conformed, Section 13(b) narrowed to uncured material breach with a 30-day notice-and-cure period, and an M&A successor carve-out added to Section 15.

Edits are legally coherent and internally consistent (Section 13(b) fix leaves clause (a), which already contains cure mechanics, untouched); the changed-character ratios reflect necessary insertions rather than gratuitous rewriting.
Comment is accurate, in the required voice and prefix, explains what changed and why, cites the playbook position and offers the affiliates-on-written-notice fallback.
